# ListenClaw

## Summary

ListenClaw is an open-source voice gateway framework that connects any microphone to any AI agent. It handles the full speech pipeline: audio capture → ASR (speech-to-text) → intent routing → AI agent → TTS (text-to-speech) → audio output.

It is designed as a pluggable middleware layer. Users configure providers via a single `config.yaml` file with no code changes required.

## Primary use cases

- Adding a voice interface to an existing AI agent (OpenClaw, OpenAI, Claude, Ollama)
- Building a self-hosted voice assistant with local models (Whisper + Ollama + Edge-TTS)
- Creating voice-controlled hardware devices that relay commands to AI agents
- Prototyping voice-first AI applications with real-time streaming

## Tech stack

- Backend: Python 3.11+, FastAPI, WebSocket, asyncio
- Frontend: Next.js 14, TailwindCSS, Web Audio API (AudioWorklet)
- Deployment: Docker Compose

## Supported providers

ASR (speech-to-text):
- Whisper (local, via faster-whisper) — default
- ElevenLabs Scribe v2 (cloud)
- Azure Speech (planned)
- Deepgram (planned)
- FunASR (planned, optimized for Mandarin Chinese)

Agent (AI brain):
- OpenClaw — primary, CLI subprocess and WebSocket modes
- OpenAI (GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, any model) — native streaming
- Anthropic Claude (claude-haiku, claude-sonnet, any model) — native streaming
- Ollama (llama3.2, qwen, mistral, any local model) — native streaming

TTS (text-to-speech):
- Edge-TTS (free, 300+ voices, multilingual) — default
- ElevenLabs (multilingual v2, streaming)
- OpenAI TTS (planned)
- Azure Neural TTS (planned)
- CosyVoice (planned, optimized for Chinese)

## Key features

- Push-to-talk (PTT) mode: client accumulates audio locally, sends as a single chunk on release, bypasses VAD
- Sentence-level streaming TTS: agent tokens are split at sentence boundaries and synthesized immediately, audio starts before the full response is ready
- Utterance queue: multiple utterances are serialized; no dropped input
- Barge-in / interrupt: user can interrupt AI mid-speech
- OpenClaw skill: a SKILL.md file that instructs OpenClaw to respond in spoken language (no markdown) when called via ListenClaw
- All messages to OpenClaw are prefixed with a context prompt so responses are TTS-friendly without requiring skill installation

## Repository structure

- `server/` — FastAPI backend, WebSocket entry point, pipeline, providers
- `server/providers/asr/` — ASR adapters (whisper, elevenlabs)
- `server/providers/agent/` — Agent adapters (openclaw, openai, claude, ollama)
- `server/providers/tts/` — TTS adapters (edge_tts, elevenlabs)
- `server/pipeline/core.py` — Audio engine, VAD, state machine
- `web/` — Next.js 14 frontend with PTT button, pipeline status bar, chat bubbles
- `openclaw-skill/` — OpenClaw skill definition and installer
- `config.example.yaml` — Full configuration reference
- `docker-compose.yml` — One-command deployment

## Quick start

```bash
git clone https://github.com/tinywatermonster/listenclaw
cp config.example.yaml config.yaml
# edit config.yaml with API keys
docker compose up
# open http://localhost:3000
```
